label: Road design
title: Roads that forgive mistakes
headline: Good road design saves lives
intro: Everyone makes mistakes on the road. Well-designed roads make sure a mistake doesn't cost a life. See how.

scenes.question: Converting junctions to roundabouts cut pedestrian crashes in Europe by about how much?

lines: Roads can be built to expect human error: a moment of distraction, a tired driver, a misjudged gap.
Let's look at five road features and what they do.

art.alt: Top-down view of a road with rumble strips along the centre line.

scenes.prompt: Rumble strips along the centre line. A tired driver drifts across.

art.alt: Top-down road with centre-line rumble strips shown or hidden.

states.label: Without
states.caption: Without them, a drifting car crosses into oncoming traffic silently.

states.label: With
states.caption: The noise and shaking wake the driver before they cross. Centre-line strips cut head-on crashes by about {claim:int.fhwa.rumble-centre}.

scenes.prompt: A refuge island in the middle of a wide road.

art.alt: Top-down road with a pedestrian refuge island shown or hidden.

states.label: Without
states.caption: Without it, people on foot must judge traffic from both directions at once.

states.label: With
states.caption: With it, they cross one direction at a time. Refuges cut pedestrian crashes by about {claim:int.fhwa.refuge}.

scenes.prompt: A busy crossroads, and the same junction as a roundabout.

art.alt: Top-down junction shown as a crossroads or a roundabout.

states.label: Crossroads
states.caption: At a crossroads, cars can meet at high speed and at right angles.

states.label: Roundabout
states.caption: A roundabout slows everyone down and turns side impacts into glancing ones. Injury crashes fell by {claim:int.iihs.roundabout-injury} in studies.

steps.title: Street lighting
steps.body: Lighting helps drivers see people on foot at night. It cuts night-time pedestrian injury crashes by about {claim:int.fhwa.lighting}.

steps.title: Wildlife fencing
steps.body: Fences with safe crossing points keep kudu and other large animals off the road. They cut large-animal collisions by about {claim:int.fencing.wildlife}.

scenes.explain: Converting junctions to roundabouts cut pedestrian crashes in Europe by about {claim:int.iihs.roundabout-ped}. Good design protects people even when someone makes a mistake.

lines: Roads, speeds, vehicles and people all work together to keep you safe.
Rumble strips are a warning: if you hit them, you need a break.
Use refuges, crossings and lit routes when you walk.
